Projects.heading: A Modern Vision That Embodies Excellence
Projects.description: Explore our gallery of past projects that reflect our uniqueness and creativity in the world of marketing and advertising, where we combine creativity and professionalism to effectively communicate your messages.

slide-1.heading: Saudi Federation for Robotics and RC Sports
slide-1.description:
The Olympic Committee-recognized federation and governing body for all radio-controlled sports.

We strengthened its digital presence through full social media management, engaging robotics and RC-sports enthusiasts with fresh, varied content that showcased the federation's activities, achievements, and contributions.

slide-2.heading: Riyad Bank
slide-2.description:
One of the largest financial institutions in Saudi Arabia and the Middle East.

We managed its social media platforms and developed innovative content aligned with the bank's direction and designed to engage its customers.

slide-3.heading: Kahatin Association
slide-3.description:
A charitable association supporting orphans in Makkah.

We delivered a distinctive digital-presence strategy, managed social media channels and paid campaigns, and produced a range of visual content in support of the association.

slide-4.heading: Half Million
slide-4.description:
One of Saudi Arabia's best-known coffee brands.

We developed an innovative, creative digital-presence strategy that kept pace with evolving social platforms and their diverse content formats.

slide-5.heading: GO Telecom
slide-5.description:
A leading telecommunications company in the Middle East, recognized for excellence in information and communications technology.

We created an innovative strategy to strengthen its social media presence and produced videos, photography, and motion graphics.

slide-6.heading: Asas Makeen
slide-6.description:
A real-estate development and investment company with 14 years of experience.

We developed its digital-presence strategy, managed its social media platforms, and ran paid advertising campaigns.

leader-1.name: Prince Salman bin Saud Al Saud
leader-1.description: We at Serajj Digital Marketing Company started from the Saudi market’s need for companies specialised in communication and marketing solutions, and we were able to build a company that provides integrated solutions that meet the needs of the private and public sectors. We continue to develop the field using artificial intelligence systems that contribute to monitoring, analysis and targeting in social media to align with 2030 vision

leader-2.name: Bassam Al Saif
leader-2.description: At Serajj Digital Marketing, we are proud to have gained the trust of more than 150 clients in the public and private sectors. One of Siraj’s most important features is an ambitious and passionate team that creates creative ideas that contribute to spreading and increasing sales for our clients. We believe that marketing is not just an advertisement. Still, it is an integrated process, and therefore we provide a comprehensive set of 360 marketing services and use modern technologies that contribute to the success of the entire marketing journey.

WhatWeAdded.description-2: We were able to be the link between our clients and their target audiences, and to build a strong and long-lasting relationship between them.
